subject: Invoice query #1
body: I was charged $49 instead of $29 for monthly plan.
resolution: Verified plan mismatch. Processed refund of $20 and adjusted billing profile.

subject: API rate limit reached #2
body: API calls return 429 status code repeatedly.
resolution: Increased tier quota and instructed user on exponential backoff retry configuration.

subject: Locked out after 3 attempts #3
body: Account locked due to wrong password.
resolution: Verified identity via SMS MFA and reset failed login counter.

subject: Dark mode support #4
body: Can you add a native dark theme mode to the Web UI?
resolution: Logged feature request FR-2045 into product backlog for Q4 consideration.

subject: Double payment issue #5
body: My credit card was charged twice on October 1st.
resolution: Identified duplicate charge in Stripe. Issued direct refund for second transaction.

subject: Slow page load time #6
body: The analytics page takes over 15 seconds to load.
resolution: Optimized database query indexing and added Redis response caching.

subject: Password reset token expired #7
body: Password reset link says token invalid.
resolution: Triggered fresh 2FA reset email and invalidated stale session tokens.

subject: Export reports to PDF #8
body: Need capability to export monthly reports to PDF format.
resolution: Added to roadmap under FR-1190; scheduled for sprint 14.

subject: Update payment method #9
body: How do I update my Visa credit card details?
resolution: Guided user to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods to edit card details.

subject: Dashboard crash on export #10
body: Exporting CSV throws a 500 server error.
resolution: Patched memory allocation limit in export microservice backend.

subject: SSO login failure #11
body: Okta SSO redirects to invalid client ID error.
resolution: Re-synced SAML 2.0 metadata certificate with client enterprise domain.

subject: Webhook integration #12
body: Requesting webhooks for real-time order notifications.
resolution: Logged under FR-882. Shared public REST API polling alternative in interim.
